name: Anne Arundel County, MD
findings: Anne Arundel County has 2,103 nonprofit organizations. 936 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 760 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Anne Arundel County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 30 research and think tank organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do research and think tank organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: 18 education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 39 would.

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 136 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 136 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
